name: Subduction
description: Sync server for Automerge apps: documents and their history, over WebSockets, signed by a key kept with its data. Takes over a Subduction app set up by hand, keeping its key and documents.

env.desc: Log level: error, warn, info, debug or trace

files.run:
#!/bin/sh
# Documents in ~/data/subduction, the server's identity key in ~/data/subduction.key: the same places the hand setup
# (nook extras/subduction-app.sh) used, so taking that app over keeps both.
set -e
mkdir -p "$HOME/data/subduction"
if [ ! -s "$HOME/data/subduction.key" ]; then
  (umask 077; head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n' > "$HOME/data/subduction.key")
fi
# glibc otherwise keeps freed memory (tested 277 MB -> 19 MB after storing 135 MB of files)
export GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.malloc.arena_max=2:glibc.malloc.trim_threshold=131072:glibc.malloc.mmap_threshold=131072
exec ./subduction_cli server --socket "127.0.0.1:$PORT" --data-dir "$HOME/data/subduction" \
  --key-file "$HOME/data/subduction.key" --service-name "$SITE_HOST"
